test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My classmate is __________ of my achievement.
solution: The correct answer is '**jealous**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**jealous**'. • It means** 'feeling angry or sad because you want to be like somebody else or because you want what somebody else has'**. [किसी के प्रति ईर्ष्यालु (क्‍योंकि आप उसके समान होना चाहते हैं या जो उसके पास है वह आप भी चाहते हैं)] • *Example: He’s always been **jealous** of his older brother.* • The adjective '**jealous**' is followed by the preposition '**of**'. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *My classmate is __**jealous**__ of my achievement.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **bitter**: caused by anger or hatred. (क्रोध या घृणा से प्रेरित, कड़वाहट-भरा) • **zealous**: using great energy and enthusiasm. (ऊर्जावान या ऊर्जापूर्ण उत्‍साही, उत्‍साहपूर्ण) • **sad**: unhappy or causing somebody to feel unhappy. (उदास या उदास करने वाला) 20c:Tc9b, The correct answer is '**Abandon**'.
